decisions.because: Counterexample (hunt round 3, 2026-10-10): a state file with MAX_KNOWN_CLAIMS + 1 retraction records restored all of them, past the bound the runtime enforces (block_table MAX_KNOWN_CLAIMS doc).
Mutation check (CI, PR #7): the drop counts and the merge-at-full and exact-end boundaries of restore were unwitnessed (12 surviving mutants). They are now observable and pinned.

statement: After a restore every bounded table holds no more than its runtime bound (claims and retraction records MAX_KNOWN_CLAIMS, events MAX_EVENTS, support targets MAX_SUPPORT_TARGETS), whatever the file holds; operator lifts are kept first and what is dropped is counted.
